assertion: before any metered judge call the run preregistered its question, bar, arms, decoys and stop rules, ran --dry-run, then --pilot 3; a full paid run without a matching pilot receipt is refused
a judge's result is reported with TPR and TNR measured on a held-out labelled split, and the observed rate is corrected, never reported raw
in skill-tdd mode the new case is shown failing on today's skill (report kept) before the skill changes, and passing after with no other flip
an OpenRouter judge in the GPT family, a bare id or a router is refused before any call, and a missing key names its variable without printing any key
a stub run, a harness run still waiting for answers, or a run with judge errors is reported as STUB, NOT_RUN or ERROR, never as PASS or KEEP
new or changed prompt words were requested from prompt-engineering, not written inside the measuring run, and the judge was not edited in the campaign it grades

every run leaves run.json, cases.jsonl and one index.jsonl line under eval/experiments/<category>/, with pinned models (requested and served), dataset hash, commit and a trace id per case; a run without its record is reported NOT_RUN
asked to choose a grader, the answer applies the order code check → golden comparison → reference-free check → binary judge → person, and uses a golden set only where a single right answer exists
